mapper.sql: v.*, j.public_id AS job_public_id, j.owner_user_id, v.title_snapshot AS title, r.version_code AS matching_rule_version, r.status AS rule_status, r.config_path, r.config_sha256
FROM sim_job_version v JOIN sim_job j ON j.id = v.job_id JOIN sim_matching_rule_version r ON r.id = v.matching_rule_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sim_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM sim_job WHERE public_id = #{publicId} AND owner_user_id = #{owner} AND status != 'ARCHIVED' FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash AS requestHash, job_public_id AS jobPublicId, response_json AS responseJson FROM sim_job_operation WHERE user_id = #{owner} AND operation_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sim_job_operation (user_id, operation_key, request_hash, job_public_id, response_json) VALUES (#{owner}, #{key}, #{hash}, #{jobId}, #{response})
INSERT INTO sim_job (owner_user_id, public_id, source_type, title, status) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{jobPublicId}, 'HR_CREATED', #{title}, 'DRAFT')

INSERT INTO sim_job_version (job_id, matching_rule_version_id, created_by, public_id, version_no, description, public_requirements_json, title_snapshot, active_criteria_json, weight_skills, weight_experience, weight_education, weight_languages, weight_projects, revision_no) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{matchingRuleVersionId}, #{createdBy}, #{publicId}, #{versionNo}, #{description}, #{publicRequirementsJson}, #{title}, #{activeCriteriaJson}, #{weightSkills}, #{weightExperience}, #{weightEducation}, #{weightLanguages}, #{weightProjects}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM sim_job_version WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
SELECT WHERE j.public_id = #{jobPublicId} AND j.status != 'ARCHIVED' AND v.status = 'DRAFT'
SELECT WHERE j.public_id = #{jobPublicId} AND j.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT WHERE j.public_id = #{jobPublicId} AND j.status != 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY v.version_no DESC

choose.when: j.owner_user_id = #{owner} AND j.status != 'ARCHIVED' AND v.version_no = (SELECT MAX(x.version_no) FROM sim_job_version x WHERE x.job_id = j.id)
choose.otherwise: j.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.version_no = (SELECT MAX(x.version_no) FROM sim_job_version x WHERE x.job_id = j.id AND x.status = 'PUBLISHED')

mapper.update: UPDATE sim_job_version SET title_snapshot = #{title}, description = #{description}, active_criteria_json = #{activeCriteriaJson}, public_requirements_json = #{publicRequirementsJson}, weight_skills = #{weightSkills}, weight_experience = #{weightExperience}, weight_education = #{weightEducation}, weight_languages = #{weightLanguages}, weight_projects = #{weightProjects}, status = #{status}, published_by = #{publishedBy}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, extraction_status = #{extractionStatus}, extraction_token = #{extractionToken}, extraction_error = #{extractionError}, extraction_started_at = #{extractionStartedAt}, revision_no = revision_no + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND revision_no = #{revisionNo} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE sim_job SET title = #{title}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('criterionType', criterion_type, 'requirementCode', requirement_code, 'payload', payload_json, 'assessmentIncluded', IF(assessment_included, CAST('true' AS JSON), CAST('false' AS JSON)), 'mandatory', IF(mandatory, CAST('true' AS JSON), CAST('false' AS JSON)), 'publicVisible', IF(public_visible, CAST('true' AS JSON), CAST('false' AS JSON)), 'reviewed', IF(reviewed, CAST('true' AS JSON), CAST('false' AS JSON)), 'evidenceExcerpt', source_excerpt, 'evidenceLocation', evidence_location, 'warnings', warnings_json) FROM sim_job_requirement WHERE job_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY display_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sim_job_requirement (job_version_id, criterion_type, requirement_code, payload_json, mandatory, public_visible, assessment_included, reviewed, source_excerpt, evidence_location, warnings_json, display_order) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{criterion}, #{code}, #{payload}, #{mandatory}, #{visible}, #{included}, #{reviewed}, #{excerpt}, #{location}, #{warnings}, #{order})
